qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global leader in nitrogen fertilizers and nitrates, but fundamentally a cyclical commodity price-taker. Lacks durable pricing power against global commodity cycles and suffers from structurally high European natural gas feedstock costs relative to North American and Middle Eastern peers. 5-year median ROIC (~7%) falls well short of the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing). World-scale nitrogen fertilizer producer exposed to global commodity price volatility and structurally disadvantaged European natural gas feedstock costs. Normalized ROIC averages 5-8%, well below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.evidence: Reported ROIC was 6.6% in 2019, 8.0% in 2020, 7.9% in 2021, cyclically spiking to 25.7% during the 2022 energy crisis, before plunging to 2.9% in 2023 and 5.0% in 2024. Multi-cycle median ROIC (~7%) is substantially below the 12% requirement. Feedstock exposure to volatile European natural gas undermines margin stability.
